segments.text: The older sister of the demon siblings. She has a slightly goofy "kogal" tone of voice.

In addition to having sex in order to supply her energy, she loves to have sex and is extremely lewd. There is no sense of innocence or maliciousness about her. She is bright and cheerful like an American porn star.
She was once summoned by Tarou who took her virginity, humiliating her in the process. She is obedient to Tarou because she knows what he is capable of, and desires to have him lose his mind someday.
When it comes to her younger brother Riine she is the exact opposite of him. She is selfish, arrogant, lecherous and has a sport attitude.
She also views Riine as a "servant" and a "toy", the siblings often indulge with each other.
Translated from the game's Official Homepage.
淫魔姉弟の姉。人間年齢だと１Ｘ歳前後。
ちょっとギャグがかったギャル口調のとおり、激しく「ビッチ」。
淫魔としてのエネルギー補給以外にもとにかくえっち好きで、とことん淫乱。
なのに淫靡だとか陰湿な雰囲気は皆無。
かつてタロウに召喚され、淫魔としての処女を奪われたうえでこってり凌辱し倒された。
タロウの実力は骨身に思い知らされているので従順だが、 なんとかうまく裏をかいてタロウをぎゃふんと言わせたく思っている。
弟のりぃねに対しては、わがままで横暴で淫乱で体育会系のりで接する、「横暴なすけべ姉」。
弟りぃねを「しもべ兼玩具」と認識していて、姉弟でさかることも日常。
The younger of the two lecherous siblings. He looks like a girl because of his sister's make up. Refers to himself in the first person with "boku".

He was raised to be polite and considerate under the pressure of his selfish older sister. Because he views his older sister as a role model, he's not a pervert despite being a whore. This is his first time in the human world and everything he sees and hears in this world is unusual to him.
With the personality of a honor student he obediently serves Tarou and has a greater number of sexual magic techniques than his sister.

Because he is a whore, he has a high level of sexual prowess, especially when he is on the receiving end of anal. He can quickly reach dry orgasms and squirts all over the place. His low tolerance for pleasure is because he is not used to it, and every time he has sex he grows accustomed to the pleasure and his role as a bitch.
Translated from the game's Official Homepage.
淫魔姉弟の弟で、人間年齢で１Ｘ歳前後。
一人称は素直な「ぼく」。
外見は姉の手によるメイクも手伝って完全に女の子。
強引かつわがままな姉に圧され、礼儀正しく思いやり深い性格に育った。
姉が反面教師であるため、淫魔のくせして淫乱ではない。
人間界に来るのは初めてで、こちらの世界で見るもの聞くものすべてが珍しく、 タロウには従順に仕える。
優等生なので性魔術の術彙は姉よりも多い。
淫魔なので性感は高く、特に肛姦されるとすぐにドライオルガに達し潮を吹きまくる。
慣れていないため快楽への耐性が低く、主人公に犯られるたびに愛奴として開花し牝化していくこととなる。
A blond-haired, blue-eyed girl from England. Refers to herself in the first person with "atashi" with slight foreign accent.
She is a first-year high school student, about half a year older than Tarou. She is transferring into the same school as Tarou.
She speaks Japanese almost as well as a native speaker, but her reading and writing skills are lacking.
In fact, like Taro, she is a Sorceress who has lived for hundreds of years by carrying over memories from her previous life.
However, in chronological age, she is younger than Tarou, and her magical knowledge and power is not nearly as good as Tarou.
In order to avenge the humiliation in her previous life, she reincarnates near Tarou and vigilantly watches for an opportunity to take revenge.
Translated from the game's Official Homepage.
英国出身の金髪碧眼。
フルネームは「エレナ(Elena)・ハーン(Hearn)」。
一人称は微妙に外人訛りの残った「アタシ」。
日本語は読み書きがまだもう一つだが、会話はほぼネイティブスピーカーと変わらない。
ときどき語尾が「外人訛り」になる程度。
１年生。タロウと同じ学校に転入。彼より半年ほど歳上。
タロウと同じく、彼女も「前生の記憶を持ち越すことで何百年も生きている魔法使い」。
ただしタロウよりもぜんぜん齢が短く、魔法知識も魔力もタロウには遠く及ばない。
そんなエレナは、復讐心で動いており、前生に辱められた屈辱を晴らすため、タロウの身近に転生してきた。
タロウはまだそれに気づいておらず、エレナは虎視眈々と復讐の機会を狙っている。
First year high school student. The way he refers to himself in the first-person, "boku" comes off as flirty.
Tarou is a quiet and inconspicuous student who looks as he could be anywhere. In fact, he is the reincarnation of a great magician who's said to be the strongest in the 20th century.
He has mastered the method of carrying over his memories to the next life, and has reincarnated repeatedly.
He regains his memories through the Book of Keys, which he entruested to Elena's grandfather, a disciple from his previous life.
He regains his memories through the Book of Keys, which he entrusted to Elena's grandfather, a disciple from his previous life.
When Tarou regains his memories, he is cunning and arrogant. He's also a seducer and a pervert.
He summons the lecherous demon siblings to embark on the research from his previous life: sexual magic.
Translated from the game's Official Homepage.
